strings.jp:
どうしたの？！
ひょっとして・・・・
体の調子がどこか悪いの！？
strings.en: What's the matter?! Don't tell me... are you feeling ill!?

strings.jp:
はいはい！甘えてないで・・・
頑張ってリハビリしてきてね。
strings.en: There, there! No being a baby, now... Go and do your best at your rehab.

strings.jp:
春はあけぼの・・・
おはよう。気分はどう？
strings.en: "In spring, it is the dawn..." Good morning. How are you feeling?

strings.jp:
吹き抜ける風が
気持ちのいい朝ねぇ・・・
strings.en: What a lovely morning, with this breeze blowing through...

strings.jp:
今日も頑張って
リハビリしなくっちゃね！
strings.en: You'll have to work hard at your rehab again today!

strings.jp:
さあ！午後の日差しが
強くならない内に、
今日も朝から頑張らなきゃ！！
strings.en: Come on! Let's get to work this morning, before the afternoon sun gets too strong!!

strings.jp:
おはよう！今日もなんだか
暑くなりそうね！！
strings.en: Good morning! It looks like another hot one today!!

strings.jp:
熊手で秋を追い出しても・・・
自然に秋は帰ってくるのよね・・・
strings.en: Drive autumn out with a rake... and still it comes back on its own, doesn't it...

strings.jp:
おはよう。
そろそろ寒くなるから・・・
冬支度を始めなくちゃね！
strings.en: Good morning. It'll be getting cold soon... We should start getting ready for winter!

strings.jp:
おはよう。今日はなんだか、
雪でも降りそうな雲行きね！
strings.en: Good morning. Those clouds look as if they might bring snow today!

strings.jp:
冬来たりなば、春遠からじ・・・
なんだか春の足音が・・・
聞こえてきたような気がしない！？
strings.en: "If winter comes, can spring be far behind..." Can't you almost hear spring's footsteps...!?
